rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The regulation defines admission, study organization, evaluation, degree requirements, rights, obligations and ethical duties at ESPRIT.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Article 1 states the regulation entered into force in 2021–2022 and replaced earlier regulations; the document cover is labeled 2026–2027.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Admissions by competitive selection, qualification review, tests and interviews are governed by conditions determined by the school management.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A student must be enrolled to follow a school program.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Enrollment requires an application file comprising diplomas, transcripts, medical file, and internship certificates.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Tuition fees must be paid by the deadlines set by the administration.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Only one enrollment deferral is permitted during the full course of study.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A request for enrollment deferral must be made on a form deposited at the school's bureau d'ordre.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A deferral request must be submitted no later than November 30 of the current year to qualify for a possible tuition refund.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: If the deferral deadline is respected, tuition is refundable except for registration fees.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Enrollment cancellation requires a cancellation request form submitted to the bureau d'ordre.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For cancellation submitted before November 30, tuition is refundable except registration fees.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For cancellation submitted December 1 through January 31, the first tuition installment is not refunded and the remainder is refundable.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For cancellation submitted from February 1 onward, no refund is made.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The academic year consists of two 16-week semesters, each including two weeks reserved for exams.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The administration communicates the annual calendar, timetables, examinations, internships, and cultural and social activities at the beginning of the academic year.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Basic instruction covers semesters 1 to 4, including applied mathematics, physics, electronics, computer science, languages and humanities/social sciences.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Specialization options listed include GI, GT, GEM and GC.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: One integrated project is planned in each academic year.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A final-year project internship is planned in semester 10.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Curricula consist of teaching units (UE) made up of one or more constituent modules (ECUE).

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: ECTS for a UE represent total learner workload including taught and untaught hours.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: One academic year represents 60 ECTS, with about five teaching units per semester.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The degree path comprises four internships when the final-year PFE internship is included.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Each UE has a description listing the responsible teacher, hours, credits, modules, prerequisites and learning outcomes.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Module syllabuses specify prerequisites, outcomes and detailed assessment methods.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A five-year engineering program applies to candidates entering with a scientific baccalaureate.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A four-year engineering program applies to candidates admitted into the first preparatory-year route indicated in the regulation.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A three-year program applies to candidates admitted by national engineering entrance examination or with the specified technical/scientific qualifications.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A two-year program applies to candidates admitted from a first master's year, first engineering-cycle year, or master's degree as indicated in the regulation.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Teaching methods include integrated courses, workshops, seminars, practicals, project/problem-based learning and projects.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: ECTS is used to plan, recognize, validate and accumulate teaching-unit learning outcomes and workload.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A full-time academic year corresponds to 60 ECTS.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: UE ECTS credits are the weighting coefficients used to calculate the overall average.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Assessment tests whether the learner achieves the learning outcomes for each ECUE.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Module assessment criteria are set by pedagogical staff, detailed in syllabuses and supplied at the first session of each module.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: An examination schedule with examination modalities must be circulated before each exam session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Final evaluation has a principal session and a retake session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Continuous assessment may include participation, written/oral tests, practical assessments, reports and oral presentations.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For exam-only modules, the module grade is 100% final exam.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For CC plus exam modules, the module grade is 40% CC plus 60% exam.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For CC plus practical/project plus exam modules, the grade is 30% CC plus 20% practical/project plus 50% exam.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For Type 1 practical/project plus exam modules, the grade is 20% practical/project plus 80% exam.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For Type 2 practical/project plus exam modules, the grade is 50% practical/project plus 50% exam.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For integrated projects, assessment weighting varies by project type and is not fixed in the regulation.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: If overall average is at least 10/20, a non-project UE is validated with UE average at least 8/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Projects are validated only with an average at least 10/20, regardless of the general-average compensation rule.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: If overall average is below 10/20, a UE is validated only with UE average at least 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A UE with average below 8/20 in both principal and retake sessions remains unvalidated and may be addressed by a later ECTS-credit validation examination.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Later credit-validation exams concern modules within an unvalidated UE whose module average was below 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The grade obtained in a credit-validation session is treated as the relevant UE grade.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The credit-validation section says a UE is validated if the resulting mark is strictly above 8/20, with projects requiring at least 10/20; clarify the exact boundary at 8/20 with the administration.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The overall academic average is an ECTS-weighted average of UE grades.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Principal-session promotion requires overall average at least 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Principal-session promotion requires exactly 60 ECTS acquired in the current year.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Principal-session promotion requires zero accumulated unvalidated prior-year ECTS.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Control-session promotion requires overall average at least 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Control-session promotion requires accumulated unvalidated prior-year ECTS at most 15.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students not meeting the stated conditions for promotion are declared repeating students.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The regulation does not explicitly state a separate current-year ECTS threshold for control-session promotion: do not invent one.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students not admitted at the principal session are authorized to take a retake of the final examination.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: If principal-session overall average is below 10/20, a student may retake modules with module average below 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: If principal-session overall average is at least 10/20, the student may retake below-10 modules within unvalidated UEs below 8/20 from current or earlier years.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Integrated projects cannot be retaken through the ordinary retake session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For a student who has passed the year, an unvalidated integrated project is handled as credits to validate during an exceptional project-validation session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Repeating students must attend project supervision sessions again to validate integrated projects.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: A retake grade may replace either the original exam grade or the continuous-assessment grade with its corresponding coefficient, whichever yields a better module result.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: If the original principal-session result is better than the retake-based alternatives, the original result is retained.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Only one repeated year is tolerated per training cycle.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: When an earlier UE was validated with grade at least 10/20, the repeating student may retake modules for grade improvement; keep the improved module mark only if higher.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: When an earlier UE is unvalidated with UE average below 10/20, repeating students must retake all modules in that UE graded below 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For mandatory repeated modules, previous marks are reset to zero; attending all sessions and taking all assessments is required.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Repeating students may also attend and retake modules above 10/20 to try to improve their overall average.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Repeating students must attend newly introduced modules and consult the head of department about changed modules and coefficients.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must arrive 15 minutes before an examination with student card or other accepted identity document.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Without an accepted identity document (CIN, passport or student card), students cannot enter the exam room and are marked absent.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The attendance sheet must be signed at the start and end of each exam.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must complete exam-script header details and indicate sheet numbers and total submitted sheets.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students arriving more than 20 minutes after exam papers are distributed cannot enter the exam room.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Late arrivals do not receive extra time to compensate for lateness.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students may leave after at least 30 minutes have elapsed from the beginning of the exam, subject to the restriction on leaving during an ongoing exam.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Leaving during the examination is prohibited; exceptional bathroom accommodations require prior medical documentation and administrative consent.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Connected devices must be switched off and stored before entering; any visible connected device during the examination is considered fraud.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Exchanging equipment such as calculators, correction tape, pens or pencils between students during exams is forbidden.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must obey examination instructions and submit their examination paper at the end.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Absence from an exam, practical assessment, or supervised test leads to a zero, subject to the documented exception review process.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: An unexcused missed final exam receives zero; retake is possible if its UE is not validated in the principal session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For final assessment absences, the listed justifications are accidents, contagious illnesses, hospitalizations, or death of a close relative; ordinary medical certificates alone are not accepted as final-exam justification.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Exceptional exam-retake requests are reviewed case by case after filing with the academic administration and consultation with department heads.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For intermediate assessment absences, the student submits justification such as hospitalization or a medical certificate to the academic administration.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Fraud or attempted fraud at a supervised test or exam can lead to disciplinary proceedings and academic/administrative sanctions.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Potential sanctions include warning, reprimand, exclusion from one or two exam sessions, restrictions on compensation or international mobility, temporary exclusion and permanent exclusion.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The three pre-PFE internships are mandatory and graded: human/social training, company immersion and engineering internship.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For each internship, students must provide a logbook, internship report and host-organization certificate.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Human/social training internship is worth 2 ECTS, lasts at least four weeks and is scheduled in summer after first common-core year.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Accepted human/social internship organizations include NGO, club, high school, enterprise and civil organization.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Company-immersion internship is worth 3 ECTS, lasts at least six weeks and is scheduled in summer after third year (first engineering-cycle year).

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Accepted company-immersion hosts include enterprises, consultancy/engineering offices, factories and experimental/research laboratories.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Engineering internship is worth 5 ECTS, lasts at least eight weeks and is scheduled in summer after fourth year (second engineering-cycle year).

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Accepted engineering internship hosts include enterprises, engineering offices, factories and experimental/research laboratories.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For human/social or immersion internship, falsified submissions result in a zero that year, with possible ECTS validation the following year.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Human/social and immersion internship complete submissions by March 1 in first principal session receive 100% of the eligible grade.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Complete submissions by June 1 in second principal session incur a two-point deduction, with a minimum mark of 10, except students with RdN submissions who retain 100%.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: At third/retake session before class board, complete human/social or immersion submissions retain 100%; incomplete files with a certificate validate at 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Falsified engineering internship submissions receive zero and require repeating the internship, with the new grade in retake session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For engineering internship, complete submission is described as from October 15; grades entered before November 22 count in principal session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For engineering internship, the academic-supervisor validation meeting is scheduled within 10 days after submission.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Engineering internship grades entered after November 22 count in retake session.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: PFE internship begins after validation of first semester of fifth year and resolution of previous-credit requirements exceeding the class council's permitted threshold; the exact threshold is not specified.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The PFE narrative specifies a minimum duration of six months, while the PFE table specifies 26 weeks, and the curriculum overview mentions 28 weeks; flag the discrepancy for staff verification.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For the 2026–2027 PFE cohort, the deadline for ending the internship is October 30, 2027.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: PFE requires a written report and an oral defense before a jury with the membership described in the regulation.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: PFE evaluation includes periodic evaluations, academic/professional/technical supervision, defense evaluation and a final jury.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: PFE report must be signed by academic and professional supervisors and stamped by the host organization.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: PFE submissions require an anti-plagiarism report with rate strictly below 18%.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: PFE submissions require an internship certificate issued by the host organization.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The PFE table indicates 30 ECTS in semester 10 (second semester of fifth year) and a minimum of 26 weeks.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Accepted PFE hosts include enterprise, engineering office, factory or experimental/research laboratory.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Engineering diploma requires validation of all UE and all corresponding study credits.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Engineering diploma requires validation of all mandatory internships.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Engineering diploma requires B2 proficiency in both French and English through internal assessment at the specified stages, or valid equivalent international certification from an accredited language center.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Engineering diploma requires PFE grade at least 10/20.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Engineering diploma requires an administrative clearance (quitus), including paid fees and returned borrowed items.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Successful graduates receive their diploma, fifth-year transcript and diploma certificate.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students missing internship validation, successful PFE defense or B2 requirements may receive an extension of up to six months.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: After extension, an unvalidated PFE may require repeating PFE with a different topic, if repetition conditions are satisfied.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Attendance is mandatory for teaching activities including courses, practical classes, seminars, internships and company visits.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Repeated absences can trigger personalized follow-up and notification to parents.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students arriving late to teaching activities may be refused admission to class.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: For a medically justified or force majeure absence, the student must provide justification to the academic administration within one week.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Attendance at all tests and exams is mandatory; unjustified absence receives zero.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must practice intellectual honesty throughout their studies.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: On detected cheating, invigilators document and seize tools used where possible and report through academic administration.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Cheating can result in school disciplinary proceedings up to exclusion.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Written reports must include bibliographic references; quoted passages must be clearly enclosed in quotation marks.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must submit works electronically for plagiarism checking; reported plagiarism is referred to relevant academic and internship staff.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must maintain clean, neat and appropriate dress and conduct; repeated breaches may result in sanctions.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must respect staff and peers and protect others from psychological, bodily or moral violence.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students must protect school equipment, facilities and cleanliness; vandalism or theft can trigger school disciplinary proceedings.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Smoking is forbidden in the covered areas of the institution specified by the regulation.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Alcohol, drugs and other toxic substances must not be distributed or consumed at the institution.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students enjoy expression, peaceful assembly and association consistent with school values and applicable regulations.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students are entitled to quality teaching, module descriptors, adequate project supervision and support.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students are entitled to information in a student portal and course materials on adopted LMS platforms.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students are entitled to respectful study conditions free of harassment, intimidation and discrimination.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Students may participate through delegates, teaching evaluation and program review.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The regulation refers to Tunisian personal data protection law 2004-63 and the school privacy policy.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: Access to student personal data is restricted to authorized parties and processors subject to confidentiality obligations.

rules.source: ESPRIT Règlement de scolarité 2026-2027 (cours du jour)
rules.rule: The regulation states students consent to personal data collection and processing according to institutional privacy policies.

ambiguities.details: Overview says 28 weeks, page 12 says at least six months, table page 14 says 26 weeks.
ambiguities.handling: Do not assert a single exact mandatory duration; request staff verification.

ambiguities.details: General rule says >=8 when general average >=10, but credit-validation rule says >8.
ambiguities.handling: Apply each clause to its own context; for exactly 8 after special credit validation ask administration.

ambiguities.details: Curriculum says four internships including PFE; section 7.9 says three stages, referring to the three before PFE.
ambiguities.handling: Interpret as 3 pre-PFE + 1 PFE; mention context when asked.

ambiguities.details: Table of contents lists 7.6 ranking, 7.7 retake, 7.8 repetition, but body uses 7.6 retake, 7.7 repetition, 7.8 exam process.
ambiguities.handling: Cite printed body section and page; do not fabricate ranking rules.

ambiguities.details: Eligibility refers to class council threshold but gives no number.
ambiguities.handling: Ask scolarité; do not invent threshold.

ambiguities.details: Specific course prerequisites, assessment schemes, schedules and competencies are in separate module documents, not this PDF.
ambiguities.handling: Require syllabus or Course Service data for course recommendations.

ambiguities.issue: Calendar dates not always anchored to academic year
ambiguities.details: Some annual November/March/June deadlines are general and not explicit year-specific calendar dates.
ambiguities.handling: Keep month/day and verify operative academic calendar before sending reminders.

ambiguities.details: The document explicitly gives October 30, 2027 as an end-of-internship date for PFE 26/27.
ambiguities.handling: Distinguish internship end date from defense/submission dates, which are not given.

ambiguities.details: Section provides >=10 overall and <=15 previous ECTS outstanding; it does not separately specify current-year acquired ECTS threshold.
ambiguities.handling: Do not infer 45/60 or another threshold; verify with administration.

ambiguities.details: One bullet permits departure after 30 minutes; another forbids leaving the room during an exam except approved circumstances.
ambiguities.handling: Present both and defer procedural interpretation to exam invigilator.

ambiguities.details: Official decisions lie with ESPRIT staff; a recommendation engine is advisory.
ambiguities.handling: Never present an AI estimate as an enrollment, graduation or promotion decision.

usage_notes: This is a structured paraphrase; check exact French PDF for binding interpretation.
Keep policy text separate from advisory logic.
Personal recommendations require securely retrieved individual student records.
Course recommendations require separate module syllabus/catalog data.
